description: BUNCH 2: CFA Mock Exam Mode + Subject Selection + AdaptiveRetest + WeakTopic implementation
steps: Add Mock mode option to TEST_MODES array in src/features/question-bank/components/session-configurator.tsx: { mode: 'Mock', label: 'CFA Mock Exam', description: '90 questions, 135 min, weighted by curriculum', defaultCount: 90 }. When Mock is selected, auto-enable timed mode with 135 min.

Implement weighted selection in src/features/question-bank/utils/question-selector.ts for Mock mode: select questions weighted by CFA L1 curriculum weights (Ethics 15%, Quant 8%, Economics 8%, FSA 13%, Corporate 8%, Equity 13%, Fixed Income 13%, Derivatives 6%, Alt Investments 6%, Portfolio Mgmt 10%). If a subject has fewer questions than its weight, take all available and redistribute remainder across other subjects.

Add subject multi-select UI to session-configurator.tsx: A chip/button-select showing all 10 CFA subjects with question count (e.g. 'Fixed Income (125)'). Allow multi-select for Topic/Subject/Mixed/Random modes. Store selected subjects in config.subject as comma-separated string.
Update selectQuestions() to handle config.subject being a comma-separated string (split and filter pool to any of the listed subjects).

Implement AdaptiveRetest mode in question-selector.ts: Read all completed sessions from localStorage ('cfa-buddy-sessions'), collect all questionIds where attempt.correct === false, filter pool to ONLY those IDs. If fewer than questionCount, take all available wrong answers.

Implement WeakTopic mode in question-selector.ts: Calculate per-subject accuracy from past sessions, filter pool to subjects where accuracy < 60%. If no weak subjects yet (new user), fall back to Random mode (just use shuffled full pool).
Run npx tsc --noEmit && npm run lint to verify.
Git commit with message: feat: add CFA mock exam mode, subject selection, adaptive retest
acceptance_criteria: Session configurator shows Mock Exam option with 90 questions, 135 min
Mock mode selects questions with CFA curriculum weighting
Subject multi-select chips appear in configurator showing available subjects with counts
AdaptiveRetest filters to only previously-wrong questions
WeakTopic filters to subjects with <60% accuracy, falls back to Random if none
findings: All implementations complete. TypeScript and lint pass cleanly. WeakTopic reads questions from localStorage key 'cfa-buddy-imported-questions' to map questionIds to subjects for accuracy calculation. Mock mode auto-enables timed mode at 135 minutes when selected.
